<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 211.0764, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈210.0691 Da. The formula that matches this mass most closely is C₉H₁₀N₂O₄ (calculated monoisotopic mass = 210.0641 Da, within typical MS tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C9H10O4N2.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10O4N2</final_answer>
